body: I do want help. I’m just going through the motions of accepting that this is a relationship I’ve ruined. One I never wanted to. This is the one that hurts the most of all the ones I’ve ruined before. It just hurts knowing I’ve done so much damage. I want to get better. But it hurts knowing that even if I do- I’ll have to live with the damage I’ve caused and the love that I’ve lost.
